goals.title: Master DSA (Grind 169)
goals.description: Complete all 169 top interview questions grouped by topic from Tech Interview Handbook

goals.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate (MLA-C02)
goals.description: Comprehensive 1000/1000 study roadmap covering Data Prep (28%), Model & FM Development (24%), Deployment & MLOps (24%), and Operations & Security (24%).

tasks.title: Two Sum
tasks.description: Find indices of two numbers that add up to target. Use a hash map to trade O(N) space for O(1) instantaneous complement lookup.
tasks.notes: Pattern: One-pass Hash Map. For each num, check if (target - num) exists in map. Time: O(N), Space: O(N). Avoid using element at current index twice.

tasks.title: Contains Duplicate
tasks.description: Determine if any value appears at least twice in an integer array. Hash set tracks uniqueness in linear time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Set. Add items one by one; return true immediately on set collision. Time: O(N), Space: O(N). Alternatively sort in O(N log N) for O(1) space.

tasks.title: Valid Anagram
tasks.description: Determine if two strings are anagrams of each other. Anagrams have identical character frequency distributions.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Frequency Array [26]. Increment for s, decrement for t. If all counts return to zero, strings are anagrams. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Ransom Note
tasks.description: Check if ransom note string can be constructed from magazine letters. Each magazine letter may only be used once.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Frequency Counting. Count available chars in magazine with array[26]; decrement for ransom note. If any count drops < 0, return false. Time: O(M+N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Longest Palindrome
tasks.description: Find length of longest palindrome that can be built with letters from string by pairing characters.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Frequency Counting. Count character frequencies. Add all even counts; for odd counts add count - 1; add +1 at end if any odd count exists for center. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Majority Element
tasks.description: Find the element appearing more than ⌊n/2⌋ times. Boyer-Moore eliminates pairing opposites to find candidate in O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Boyer-Moore Voting. Count = 0, candidate = None. If count == 0, candidate = num. Count += 1 if num == candidate else -1. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Longest Common Prefix
tasks.description: Find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. Compare characters column-by-column across all words.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Vertical Scanning. Compare character at index i across all strings simultaneously. Stop at first mismatch or word end. Time: O(S), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Group Anagrams
tasks.description: Group anagrams together into sublists. Use a canonical representation (sorted string or 26-char count tuple) as hash map key.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Map with Canonical Key. Key = tuple(char_counts) or ''.join(sorted(word)). Append word to map[key]. Time: O(N * K log K), Space: O(N * K).

tasks.title: Product of Array Except Self
tasks.description: Calculate output array where output[i] equals product of all elements except nums[i] without using division.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Two-Pass Running Product. Forward pass builds prefix products; backward pass multiplies running suffix product in-place. Time: O(N), Space: O(1) auxiliary.

tasks.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
tasks.description: Find length of longest consecutive elements sequence in unsorted array in O(N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Set Sequence Head. Store all nums in set. Only start counting sequence length if num - 1 is NOT in set (ensures sequence head). Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Encode and Decode Strings
tasks.description: Design algorithm to encode list of strings to a string and decode string back to list of strings without delimiter collisions.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Length-Header Encoding. Format each string as '{len}#{string}'. Decode by parsing digits up to '#' as slice length. Time: O(N), Space: O(1) overhead.

tasks.title: Rotate Array
tasks.description: Rotate array to right by k steps in-place. k = k % n prevents redundant cycles.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Three-Reversal Trick. Reverse entire array, reverse first k elements, reverse remaining n - k elements. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Largest Number
tasks.description: Given list of non-negative integers, arrange them such that they form largest number.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Custom Sorting Comparator. Compare two numbers a and b as strings: if a + b > b + a, a should come before b. Sort using custom comparator. Strip leading zeroes for [0, 0]. Time: O(N log N * K), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: String to Integer (atoi)
tasks.subtopic: Finite State Machine / Strict Clamp String Parser
tasks.description: Implement myAtoi(string s) which converts string to 32-bit signed integer with whitespace trimming, sign check, and integer clamping.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Deterministic Parsing State. 1) Discard leading whitespace. 2) Check for optional '+' or '-' sign. 3) Read consecutive digits, clamping to [-2^31, 2^31 - 1] on overflow. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
tasks.description: Design data structure supporting insert, remove, and getRandom in average O(1) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Map + Dynamic Array. Map stores val -> array index. To delete O(1), swap target with last element in array, update map, pop back. Time: O(1), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: First Missing Positive
tasks.description: Find smallest missing positive integer in unsorted array in O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Cyclic Sort / Index As Hash Key. Place each positive x in range [1, n] at nums[x - 1] via while-swaps. First index i where nums[i] != i + 1 yields i + 1. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Valid Palindrome
tasks.description: Determine if string is palindrome considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Inward Two Pointers. Left at 0, right at n - 1. Increment left/decrement right over non-alphanumeric chars; compare lowercase chars. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Move Zeroes
tasks.description: Move all 0's to end of array while maintaining relative order of non-zero elements in-place.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Read/Write Pointers. Slow pointer tracks position for next non-zero. Fast pointer scans array and swaps non-zeroes forward. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Squares of a Sorted Array
tasks.subtopic: Two Pointers on Symmetrically Sorted Array
tasks.description: Given sorted integer array (containing negative numbers), return array of squares in sorted order.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Inward Pointers from Extremes. Largest squares occur at either extreme left (large negatives) or extreme right (large positives). Fill result backwards. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Container With Most Water
tasks.description: Find two lines that together with x-axis forms container holding maximum water.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Greedy Inward Pointers. Left = 0, right = n - 1. Area = (right - left) * min(h[left], h[right]). Greedily move the pointer with smaller height inward. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: 3Sum
tasks.description: Find all unique triplets in array that sum to zero.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Sort + Two Pointers. Sort array. Fix nums[i]; use left/right pointers to find pairs summing to -nums[i]. Skip duplicate values for i, left, and right. Time: O(N^2), Space: O(1) or O(N) sort.

tasks.title: 3Sum Closest
tasks.description: Find three integers in array whose sum is closest to target.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Sort + Two Pointers. Sort array. For each base element, use two pointers inward; update closest_sum if |sum - target| < |closest - target|. Time: O(N^2), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Sort Colors
tasks.description: Sort array with values 0, 1, 2 in-place in a single pass without using library sort.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Dijkstra's 3-Way Partition. Pointers low, mid, high. Swap 0s to low, 2s to high, increment mid on 1. All elements partitioned in one pass. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Next Permutation
tasks.description: Rearrange numbers into lexicographically next greater permutation in-place.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Next Permutation Algorithm. 1) Find largest i where nums[i] < nums[i+1]. 2) Find largest j > i where nums[j] > nums[i]. 3) Swap nums[i] and nums[j]. 4) Reverse suffix nums[i+1:]. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
tasks.description: Find longest palindromic substring in s in O(N^2) time and O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Two Pointers Center Expansion. There are 2N - 1 possible centers: single characters (i) for odd palindromes and pairs (i, i+1) for even palindromes. Expand outward while characters match. Time: O(N^2), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
tasks.description: Find maximum profit by choosing a single day to buy stock and a different day in future to sell.
tasks.notes: Pattern: One-Pass Min-Tracking Window. Track min_price seen so far; at each price, potential profit is price - min_price. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
tasks.subtopic: Dynamic Window with Last Seen Index
tasks.description: Find length of longest substring without repeating characters.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Variable-Size Sliding Window. Expand right pointer. Store last seen index of each char in hash map. If char seen within window, slide left to map[char] + 1. Time: O(N), Space: O(min(N, M)).

tasks.title: Find All Anagrams in a String
tasks.description: Find all start indices of p's anagrams in s.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Fixed Window of size len(p). Maintain character frequency array for window in s. Slide window one step: add right char count, remove left char count. Compare arrays in O(1). Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
tasks.subtopic: Dynamic Window with Max Frequency Count
tasks.description: Find length of longest substring containing same letter after replacing at most k characters.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Sliding Window with Max Frequency. Window validity condition: window_len - max_freq <= k. If invalid, increment left pointer. Window never needs to shrink in max size. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Minimum Window Substring
tasks.description: Find minimum window substring in s that contains all characters of t in O(N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Minimum Sliding Window. Expand right to satisfy frequency requirements (have == need). Contract left pointer while window remains valid to find local minimum. Time: O(N), Space: O(total chars).

tasks.title: Sliding Window Maximum
tasks.description: Return maximum sliding window of size k moving across array from left to right in O(N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Monotonic Deque. Store array indices in deque with values in strictly decreasing order. Pop front indices older than left boundary; pop back indices whose values are <= incoming element. Time: O(N), Space: O(k).

tasks.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
tasks.description: Find total number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k in O(N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Prefix Sum + Hash Map. Subarray sum(i, j) = prefix[j] - prefix[i-1] == k => prefix[i-1] == prefix[j] - k. Maintain frequency map of prefix sums; add count of (curr_sum - k) at each step. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Contiguous Array
tasks.subtopic: Prefix Sum Relative Offset Hash Map
tasks.description: Find maximum length of contiguous subarray with equal number of 0s and 1s.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Transformed Prefix Sum. Treat 0 as -1 and 1 as +1. Equal 0s and 1s means running sum returns to a previously seen value. Store first occurrence index of each prefix sum in map. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Random Pick with Weight
tasks.subtopic: Prefix Sum Array + Binary Search Probability Pick
tasks.description: Given array of positive integers w, randomly pick an index in proportion to its weight w[i].
tasks.notes: Pattern: Prefix Sums + Binary Search. Compute prefix sum of weights array where total = prefix[-1]. Generate random target in [0, total). Use binary search (bisect_right) to find index in O(log N) per pick. Time: O(log N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Meeting Rooms
tasks.description: Determine if a person could attend all meetings given array of meeting time intervals.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Interval Sorting. Sort meetings by start time: intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x[0]). Attendable iff intervals[i][0] >= intervals[i-1][1] for all consecutive meetings. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Merge Intervals
tasks.description: Merge all overlapping intervals and return array of non-overlapping intervals.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Sort + Merge. Sort by interval start. If current start <= previous end, merge by end = max(previous.end, current.end); else append new interval. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Insert Interval
tasks.description: Insert new interval into sorted non-overlapping intervals and merge if necessary.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 3-Stage Linear Pass. 1) Append intervals ending before newInterval starts. 2) Merge all overlapping intervals into newInterval (min start, max end). 3) Append remaining intervals. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Meeting Rooms II
tasks.description: Find minimum number of conference rooms required to hold all meetings.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Min-Heap or Sweep Line. Sort meetings by start time. Push end times into min-heap. If earliest ending meeting ends before current start, pop heap (reuse room); push current end time. Heap size is rooms needed. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
tasks.description: Find minimum number of intervals to remove to make the rest of intervals non-overlapping.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Greedy Activity Selection. Sort intervals by end time. Always keep interval that finishes earliest. If next interval starts before current end, increment removal count; otherwise update current end. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Employee Free Time
tasks.description: Find list of common free time intervals for all employees given their working schedules.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Interval Merging Sweep. Flatten all employee work intervals into one list and sort by start time. Merge overlapping working intervals; gaps between consecutive merged work blocks constitute common free time. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Valid Parentheses
tasks.description: Determine if input string containing brackets '()[]{}' is valid and properly closed in correct order.
tasks.notes: Pattern: LIFO Stack. Push opening brackets (or expected closing brackets) to stack. On closing bracket, pop and verify matching type. Stack must be empty at end. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Backspace String Compare
tasks.description: Compare two strings containing '#' backspaces to verify if they produce equal keystroke text.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Stack Simulation. Push characters to stack; pop on '#' if stack non-empty. Compare resulting stack contents. Can also be optimized with backwards two pointers. Time: O(M+N), Space: O(M+N).

tasks.title: Implement Queue using Stacks
tasks.description: Implement first-in-first-out (FIFO) queue using only two LIFO stacks.
tasks.notes: Pattern: In-Stack & Out-Stack. Push directly to in_stack. For pop/peek, if out_stack is empty, pop all elements from in_stack and push to out_stack (reverses order to FIFO). Amortized Time: O(1), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Min Stack
tasks.description: Design stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving minimum element in O(1) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Dual Stack or Tuple Pairs. Push (val, min(val, min_so_far)) onto single stack, or maintain parallel min_stack where top is always current minimum. Time: O(1) all ops, Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
tasks.description: Evaluate value of arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation (RPN).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Postfix Evaluation Stack. Numbers are pushed onto stack. On operator (+, -, *, /), pop right operand then left operand, perform operation, push result back. Division truncates toward zero. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Daily Temperatures
tasks.subtopic: Monotonic Decreasing Stack for Next Greater
tasks.description: Given daily temperatures, return array where answer[i] is number of days to wait for warmer temperature.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Monotonic Decreasing Stack. Store temperature indices. When current temperature is warmer than stack top, pop index and set answer[popped] = current_i - popped. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Asteroid Collision
tasks.description: Find state of asteroids after all collisions: positive moves right, negative moves left; larger destroys smaller.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Collision Stack. Push asteroids. Collision only occurs if top is positive (> 0) and current is negative (< 0). Loop pop while top is smaller; destroy both if equal; push current only if it survives. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Decode String
tasks.description: Decode encoded string where k[encoded_string] repeats encoded_string exactly k times.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Nested Expression Stack. Track curr_str and curr_num. On '[', push (curr_str, curr_num) onto stack, reset curr_str = '', curr_num = 0. On ']', pop (prev_str, repeat_num) and curr_str = prev_str + curr_str * repeat_num. Time: O(Output Length), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Basic Calculator II
tasks.description: Implement basic calculator to evaluate string containing non-negative integers and operators '+', '-', '*', '/'.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Precedence Stack. Process numbers with previous operator. For '+' push num, for '-' push -num, for '*' and '/' pop top and evaluate immediately. Sum all numbers on stack at end. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Design Hit Counter
tasks.subtopic: Sliding Second Deque / Queue Rolling Count
tasks.description: Design hit counter which counts number of hits received in past 5 minutes (300 seconds).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Time Window Deque or Ring Buffer. Store hits as (timestamp, count) in deque. For getHits(t), pop front timestamps <= t - 300. Return sum of surviving counts in deque. Time: O(1) amortized, Space: O(300).

tasks.title: Trapping Rain Water
tasks.subtopic: Monotonic Stack / Two Pointers Water Trap
tasks.description: Compute how much water elevation map can trap after raining.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Inward Two Pointers with Max Tracking. Water above bar i is min(left_max, right_max) - height[i]. Advance the pointer with smaller max boundary inward accumulating trapped water. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
tasks.description: Find area of largest rectangle in histogram bars in O(N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Monotonic Increasing Stack of Indices. When current bar is shorter than stack top, pop bar h; it forms rectangle of height h between current index and new stack top. Append sentinel 0 height at end to flush stack. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
tasks.description: Find length of longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Index Stack. Initialize stack with -1 as base index. Push index of '('. On ')', pop stack. If stack empty, push current index as new base; else max_len = max(max_len, i - stack_top). Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Maximum Frequency Stack
tasks.description: Design stack-like data structure that pops most frequent element; if tie, pops element closest to top.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Frequency-to-Stack Map. Map val -> freq, and map freq -> stack of elements. Track max_freq. Push increments freq and pushes to group[freq]. Pop pops from group[max_freq] and decrements max_freq if empty. Time: O(1) all ops, Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Basic Calculator
tasks.description: Implement basic calculator to evaluate string containing integers, '+', '-', '(', and ')'.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Sign & Parentheses Stack. Track result and current sign (+1 or -1). On '(', push (result, sign) to stack and reset. On ')', pop (prev_result, prev_sign) and compute prev_result + prev_sign * result. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Reverse Linked List
tasks.description: Reverse a singly linked list in-place and return new head.
tasks.notes: Pattern: In-Place Pointer Reversal. Maintain prev = None, curr = head. Save nxt = curr.next, point curr.next = prev, advance prev = curr, curr = nxt. Return prev. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
tasks.description: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list by splicing nodes together.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Dummy Sentinel Head. Use dummy node. Compare l1.val and l2.val; attach smaller node to tail; advance corresponding pointer. Attach non-null remainder list at end. Time: O(N+M), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Linked List Cycle
tasks.description: Determine if linked list has a cycle using O(1) memory.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare. Slow moves 1 step, fast moves 2 steps. If fast or fast.next reaches null, no cycle; if slow and fast meet, cycle detected. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Middle of the Linked List
tasks.description: Return middle node of linked list; if two middle nodes, return the second middle node.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 2-to-1 Speed Pointers. Slow moves 1 step, fast moves 2 steps. When fast reaches end of list (fast is null or fast.next is null), slow is exactly at middle node. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Palindrome Linked List
tasks.subtopic: Midpoint Split + Half Reversal + Two Pointers
tasks.description: Determine if singly linked list is palindrome in O(N) time and O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Split, Reverse & Compare. 1) Find middle with slow/fast. 2) Reverse second half in-place. 3) Compare nodes from head and reversed second half. Restore list optionally. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
tasks.description: Remove nth node from end of list and return head in one pass.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Offset Fast/Slow Pointers. Use dummy node before head. Advance fast pointer n + 1 steps ahead. Move both fast and slow together until fast is null; slow.next = slow.next.next. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
tasks.description: Swap every two adjacent nodes in singly linked list without modifying node values.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Dummy Head + 3-Pointer Rewire. Dummy points to head. For pair (first, second), point dummy.next = second, first.next = second.next, second.next = first; advance dummy. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Add Two Numbers
tasks.description: Add two numbers represented by linked lists in reverse order; return sum as linked list.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Full Adder Simulation with Carry. Traverse both lists together. Node val = (v1 + v2 + carry) % 10, carry = (v1 + v2 + carry) // 10. Append extra node for final carry if > 0. Time: O(max(N, M)), Space: O(max(N, M)).

tasks.title: Odd Even Linked List
tasks.description: Group all odd nodes together followed by even nodes in-place in O(N) time and O(1) extra space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Two Pointers Chain Partitioning. Maintain odd and even pointers and save even_head. Connect odd.next = even.next; advance odd; connect even.next = odd.next; advance even. Join odd.next = even_head. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Rotate List
tasks.description: Rotate list to right by k places in-place.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Circular Ring Splitting. Find list length and connect tail to head, forming circular list. New tail is at index (length - k % length - 1); break circular link after new tail. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Reorder List
tasks.subtopic: Find Midpoint + Reverse Half + Alternating Merge
tasks.description: Reorder linked list L0 -> L1 -> ... -> Ln-1 -> Ln into L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> Ln-1 -> L2 -> Ln-2 in-place.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 3-Step In-Place Reorder. 1) Find middle with slow/fast. 2) Reverse second half. 3) Weave nodes alternately between first half and reversed second half. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Find the Duplicate Number
tasks.subtopic: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare on Array Pointers
tasks.description: Find duplicate number in array of n + 1 integers where each integer is in [1, n] in O(N) time and O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Array as Implicit Linked List Cycle. Treat nums[i] as pointer to next index nums[nums[i]]. Apply Floyd's fast/slow pointers to find cycle intersection, then reset slow to 0 to locate entrance. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Sort List
tasks.subtopic: Top-Down / Bottom-Up Merge Sort on Lists
tasks.description: Sort linked list in O(N log N) time and O(log N) or O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Merge Sort on Linked List. Find middle using slow/fast and split into two lists. Recursively sort each half; merge two sorted lists using dummy head helper. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(log N) call stack.

tasks.title: LRU Cache
tasks.subtopic: Doubly Linked List + Hash Map Node Index
tasks.description: Design Least Recently Used (LRU) cache supporting get and put in O(1) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Map + Doubly Linked List. Map stores key -> Node. DLL maintains usage order (most recent at head, least recent at tail) with dummy head and tail. On get/put, move node to head; on capacity, evict node at tail. Time: O(1) all ops, Space: O(capacity).

tasks.title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
tasks.description: Reverse nodes of linked list k at a time; leave remaining nodes as-is if fewer than k remain.
tasks.notes: Pattern: K-Node Lookahead & Segment Reversal. Count k nodes ahead. If k nodes exist, reverse k nodes segment in-place, connect with previous segment tail and recurse/iterate on next segment. Time: O(N), Space: O(1) iterative.

tasks.title: Binary Search
tasks.description: Search target in sorted array in O(log N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Classic Binary Search. low = 0, high = n - 1. mid = low + (high - low) // 2. If nums[mid] == target return mid; else narrow search half. Time: O(log N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: First Bad Version
tasks.description: Find first bad version using API isBadVersion(v) while minimizing calls.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Monotonic Predicate Binary Search. low = 1, high = n. If isBadVersion(mid) is true, first bad version could be mid or to the left (high = mid); else low = mid + 1. Returns low. Time: O(log N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
tasks.description: Search target in rotated sorted array with distinct values in O(log N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Rotated Binary Search. At mid, at least one half [low, mid] or [mid, high] is normally sorted. Check if target lies within bounds of the sorted half; if yes search it, else search opposite half. Time: O(log N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
tasks.description: Find minimum element in rotated sorted array of unique elements in O(log N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Inflection Point Search. Compare nums[mid] with nums[high]. If nums[mid] > nums[high], minimum lies strictly to the right (low = mid + 1); else minimum is at mid or left (high = mid). Time: O(log N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Search a 2D Matrix
tasks.description: Search target in m x n integer matrix where each row is sorted and first integer of each row is greater than last of previous.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Virtual 1D Array. Matrix maps to 1D index 0 .. m*n - 1. For mid, matrix[mid // n][mid % n] gives cell value. Standard binary search runs in O(log(M*N)) time. Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Time Based Key-Value Store
tasks.subtopic: Bucket Array + Upper Bound Timestamp Search
tasks.description: Design time-based key-value store that stores multiple values at different timestamps and retrieves key's value at timestamp_prev <= timestamp.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Map to Sorted List + Binary Search. Map key -> list of (timestamp, value). Since timestamps are strictly increasing, use binary search (bisect_right - 1) to find largest timestamp <= query. Time: O(log N) get, O(1) set, Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Find K Closest Elements
tasks.subtopic: Binary Search on Left Bound Window
tasks.description: Find k closest elements to x in sorted array; return sorted result.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Binary Search on Window Start. Search for optimal start index in range [0, n - k]. Compare distance: if x - arr[mid] > arr[mid + k] - x, window must shift right (low = mid + 1); else high = mid. Time: O(log(N - k) + k), Space: O(k).

tasks.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
tasks.description: Find median of two sorted arrays of sizes m and n in O(log(min(m, n))) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Partition Balancing Binary Search. Binary search partition cut in smaller array. Derive partition cut in second array such that left partition has half total elements and max(left1, left2) <= min(right1, right2). Time: O(log(min(M, N))), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Set Matrix Zeroes
tasks.subtopic: In-Place First Row & Column Sentinel Flags
tasks.description: Given m x n matrix, if element is 0, set entire row and column to 0 in-place in O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: First Row & Column as Flags. Use row 0 and col 0 to store zeroes flags for matrix body. Use separate boolean variables to track whether row 0 and col 0 originally contained zeroes. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Rotate Image
tasks.description: Rotate n x n 2D matrix by 90 degrees clockwise in-place.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Transpose + Horizontal Reflection. 1) Transpose matrix (swap matrix[i][j] with matrix[j][i] across main diagonal). 2) Reverse each row horizontally: row.reverse(). Time: O(N^2), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Spiral Matrix
tasks.description: Return all elements of m x n matrix in spiral order.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 4-Boundary Pointers (top, bottom, left, right). Traverse top row left-to-right, contract top; traverse right column top-to-bottom, contract right; traverse bottom row right-to-left, contract bottom; traverse left column bottom-to-top, contract left. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(1) auxiliary.

tasks.title: Valid Sudoku
tasks.description: Determine if 9 x 9 Sudoku board is valid (no duplicate digits 1-9 in any row, column, or 3x3 subgrid).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Hash Sets or Bitmasks. Maintain 9 sets for rows, 9 for cols, 9 for 3x3 boxes (box index: (r // 3) * 3 + (c // 3)). If digit already present in any set, board is invalid. Time: O(1), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Invert Binary Tree
tasks.description: Invert a binary tree (mirror horizontally) and return its root.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Postorder / Preorder DFS Swap. Swap left and right child pointers: root.left, root.right = invert(root.right), invert(root.left). Base case returns null. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
tasks.description: Find maximum depth (number of nodes along longest path from root down to farthest leaf) of binary tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Postorder Height DFS. If root is null, return 0. Depth = 1 + max(maxDepth(root.left), maxDepth(root.right)). Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Same Tree
tasks.description: Check if two binary trees are structurally identical and have the same node values.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Dual-Tree Preorder Traversal. If both null -> true; if one null or values differ -> false; return isSameTree(p.left, q.left) and isSameTree(p.right, q.right). Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Symmetric Tree
tasks.description: Check whether a binary tree is a mirror of itself (symmetric around its center).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Mirror Pair DFS. Helper isMirror(t1, t2): t1.val == t2.val and isMirror(t1.left, t2.right) and isMirror(t1.right, t2.left). Base case both null true, one null false. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Subtree of Another Tree
tasks.description: Determine if binary tree root contains a subtree with same structure and values as subRoot.
tasks.notes: Pattern: DFS + Tree Equality Helper. At each node in root, check if isSameTree(root, subRoot). If not, recursively check isSubtree(root.left, subRoot) or isSubtree(root.right, subRoot). Time: O(N * M), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
tasks.description: Compute diameter (length of longest path between any two nodes) of binary tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bottom-Up Postorder DFS. At each node, compute height of left and right subtrees. Update global_diameter = max(global_diameter, left_h + right_h). Return 1 + max(left_h, right_h). Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Balanced Binary Tree
tasks.description: Determine if binary tree is height-balanced (depth of two subtrees of every node never differs by > 1).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Early-Exit Postorder DFS. Return height if balanced; return -1 sentinel immediately if left or right subtree is unbalanced or |left_h - right_h| > 1. Avoids O(N^2) top-down checks. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Path Sum II
tasks.description: Find all root-to-leaf paths where sum of node values equals targetSum.
tasks.notes: Pattern: DFS Path Backtracking. Maintain current_path list and remaining sum. At leaf node, if remaining == leaf.val, add copy of current_path to result. Pop node from path on backtrack. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
tasks.description: Return level order traversal of binary tree's node values (level by level, left to right).
tasks.notes: Pattern: BFS Queue by Level. Initialize queue with root. For each level, record queue length L; pop L nodes and append to level list; enqueue non-null children. Time: O(N), Space: O(W) where W is max tree width.

tasks.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
tasks.subtopic: Level Order Last Element / Rightmost DFS
tasks.description: Return values of nodes visible from right side of binary tree ordered from top to bottom.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Level Order BFS (Take Last Element) or DFS visiting right subtree before left. In DFS, add node value if current depth equals result list length. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
tasks.description: Find lowest common ancestor (LCA) of two given nodes p and q in binary tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Postorder LCA DFS. If root is null, p, or q, return root. Recurse left and right. If both return non-null, root is LCA; if only one returns non-null, propagate that non-null node upward. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
tasks.description: Construct binary tree from preorder and inorder traversal arrays.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Divide & Conquer Tree Construction. First element of preorder is root. Find root index in inorder using hash map. Elements to left in inorder form left subtree; elements to right form right subtree. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
tasks.description: Return zigzag level order traversal (left to right, then right to left, alternating).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Level Order BFS with Direction Flag. Run standard level order BFS with queue. If current level index is odd, reverse level list (or append to deque front) before adding to result. Time: O(N), Space: O(W).

tasks.title: Maximum Width of Binary Tree
tasks.subtopic: BFS Level Width with Coordinate Indexing
tasks.description: Find maximum width (max distance between leftmost and rightmost non-null nodes) of binary tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Level Order BFS with Binary Heap Indexing. Root index = 0; left child = 2*i + 1, right child = 2*i + 2. Normalize indices per level by subtracting first node's index. Width = last_index - first_index + 1. Time: O(N), Space: O(W).

tasks.title: Path Sum III
tasks.subtopic: Prefix Sum Hash Map on Tree Ancestor Paths
tasks.description: Find number of paths that sum to targetSum in binary tree (path does not need to start at root or end at leaf).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Prefix Sum Hash Map on DFS Call Stack. Maintain running prefix sum and map of seen prefix sums along current ancestor branch. At each node, count += map[curr_sum - target]. Decrement map count on backtrack. Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
tasks.subtopic: Postorder Subtree Gain & Global Max Path
tasks.description: Find maximum path sum of any non-empty path in binary tree (any node to any node).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Postorder Gain Maximization. Helper returns max gain node can contribute to parent: node.val + max(0, max(left_gain, right_gain)). Update global max_sum with node.val + max(0, left_gain) + max(0, right_gain). Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
tasks.subtopic: Preorder DFS with Null Sentinels Serialization
tasks.description: Design algorithm to serialize binary tree to string and deserialize string back to binary tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Preorder DFS with Delimiters. Serialize: preorder DFS emitting val and 'N' for null, comma-separated. Deserialize: split string into token queue/iterator; recursively reconstruct node popping front token. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
tasks.description: Find lowest common ancestor (LCA) of two given nodes in a Binary Search Tree (BST).
tasks.notes: Pattern: BST Invariant Navigation. If both p and q values are strictly less than root.val, LCA is in left subtree; if both strictly greater, in right subtree. First node where paths diverge is the LCA. Time: O(H), Space: O(1) iterative.

tasks.title: Convert Sorted Array to Binary Search Tree
tasks.description: Convert sorted integer array into height-balanced binary search tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Midpoint Binary Search Tree Construction. Choose midpoint of array as root to guarantee balanced heights; recurse on left half for root.left, right half for root.right. Time: O(N), Space: O(log N) stack.

tasks.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
tasks.description: Determine if a binary tree is a valid Binary Search Tree (BST).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Valid Interval Propagation. Pass allowed range (low, high) recursively. Check that low < node.val < high. For left child, update high = node.val; for right child, update low = node.val. Initial range (-inf, +inf). Time: O(N), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
tasks.description: Find kth smallest element in a binary search tree (1-indexed).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Inorder Traversal (Sorted BST Invariant). Inorder traversal of BST visits nodes in strictly ascending order. Traverse iteratively with stack; decrement k on each popped node; when k reaches 0, return popped value. Time: O(H + k), Space: O(H).

tasks.title: Inorder Successor in BST
tasks.subtopic: BST Successor Traversal with Value Comp
tasks.description: Find in-order successor of given node p in BST (node with smallest key greater than p.val).
tasks.notes: Pattern: BST Successor Search. Start at root. If p.val >= root.val, successor must be in right subtree. If p.val < root.val, root is potential successor; record candidate and explore left subtree for closer successor. Time: O(H), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: K Closest Points to Origin
tasks.subtopic: Max-Heap of Top K Distances / Quickselect
tasks.description: Find k closest points to origin (0, 0) on XY plane.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Max-Heap of Size K or Quickselect. Maintain max-heap of size K storing (-distance, point). For each point, if distance < top, replace top. Heap retains k smallest distances. Time: O(N log K), Space: O(K).

tasks.title: Top K Frequent Words
tasks.description: Find k most frequent words in list; return words sorted by frequency descending, then lexicographical ascending.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Min-Heap with Custom Comparison. Map word frequencies. Maintain min-heap of size K with custom comparator: (freq, ReverseOrder(word)). Heap root is smallest freq / lexicographically largest. Time: O(N log K), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
tasks.description: Find kth largest element in an unsorted array in O(N) average time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Min-Heap of Size K or Quickselect. Maintain min-heap of size K; push elements, pop when size > K; root holds kth largest. Alternatively Quickselect with random pivot achieves O(N) average time O(1) space.

tasks.title: Task Scheduler
tasks.description: Find least number of intervals to complete CPU tasks with cooldown period n between identical tasks.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Greedy Frequency Counting or Max-Heap. Most frequent task dominates schedule. Max intervals bounded by (max_freq - 1) * (n + 1) + count_of_max_freq_tasks. Return max(len(tasks), formula). Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
tasks.subtopic: K-Way Merge with Min-Heap of Node Heads
tasks.description: Merge k sorted linked lists and return as one sorted list.
tasks.notes: Pattern: K-Way Merge with Min-Heap. Insert head node of all k lists into min-heap. Pop smallest node, append to merged list tail, and push popped_node.next into heap until empty. Time: O(N log k), Space: O(k).

tasks.title: Find Median from Data Stream
tasks.description: Design data structure that supports adding numbers from data stream and finding median in O(1) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Two Balanced Heaps. Max-heap stores smaller half; min-heap stores larger half. Balance heaps so sizes differ by at most 1. Median is top of larger heap (odd count) or average of two tops (even count). Time: O(log N) add, O(1) findMedian, Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists
tasks.description: Find smallest range [a, b] that includes at least one number from each of k sorted lists.
tasks.notes: Pattern: K-Way Min-Heap with Max Tracker. Heap stores (val, list_idx, elem_idx) for one element per list. Track current_max. Range is current_max - heap_min.val. Advance pointer of minimum element to shrink range. Time: O(N log k), Space: O(k).

tasks.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
tasks.description: Implement a trie with insert, search, and startsWith methods.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Prefix Tree. Each TrieNode holds children array [26] and boolean is_end. Insert creates nodes along word characters. Search checks existence and is_end. StartsWith checks existence only. Time: O(L) per op, Space: O(Total Chars).

tasks.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
tasks.description: Design data structure supporting adding words and searching words with '.' matching any letter.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Trie + DFS Wildcard Branching. Insert into standard Trie. For search, traverse nodes. When '.' encountered, recursively try all non-null children; for regular char, follow specific child pointer. Time: O(M) without dots, O(26^dots) worst case, Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Design In-Memory File System
tasks.description: Design in-memory file system supporting ls, mkdir, addContentToFile, and readContentFromFile.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Trie-Like Directory Hierarchy. Node contains is_file boolean, content string, and children hash map of names to Nodes. Split path by '/' and traverse down children map. Time: O(Path Depth), Space: O(Filesystem Size).

tasks.title: Palindrome Pairs
tasks.subtopic: Prefix/Suffix Trie Matching with Palindrome Check
tasks.description: Find all pairs of distinct indices (i, j) in words list such that words[i] + words[j] is a palindrome.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Reversed Words in Trie. Insert reversed words into Trie, storing word index and list of remaining palindrome suffixes. Search each word in Trie to find matching prefixes/suffixes in O(N * K^2) time.

tasks.title: Pow(x, n)
tasks.description: Implement pow(x, n) which calculates x raised to power n in O(log N) time using recursion.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Fast Exponentiation (Divide & Conquer). Master the recursive base case and subproblem halving: x^n = (x*x)^(n//2) if even, x * (x*x)^((n-1)//2) if odd. Foundational for recursive branching. Time: O(log N), Space: O(log N).

tasks.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
tasks.description: Given string containing digits 2-9, return all possible letter combinations phone number could represent.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Combinatorial DFS. Map digits to letters. At index i, loop over possible letters for digit[i], append to path, recurse for i + 1, pop character on backtrack. Time: O(4^N), Space: O(N) call stack.

tasks.title: Subsets
tasks.description: Given integer array of unique elements, return power set (all possible subsets).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Binary Choice Backtracking. At each index i, branch two decisions: 1) Include nums[i] in current subset and recurse, 2) Exclude nums[i] and recurse. Total 2^N subsets. Time: O(N * 2^N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Permutations
tasks.description: Given array of distinct integers, return all possible permutations.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Permutation Backtracking. Maintain visited boolean array. For each unused element, mark visited, add to current permutation, recurse, unmark visited on backtrack. Base case len(path) == len(nums). Time: O(N * N!), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Combination Sum
tasks.subtopic: Unbounded Element Pick with Target Balance
tasks.description: Find all unique combinations of candidate numbers that sum to target, where same number may be chosen unlimited times.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Unbounded Choice Backtracking. Sort candidates. At index i, include candidate[i], subtract from target, recurse on same index i (allowing reuse). If target < 0, prune. Recurse on i + 1 to explore without candidate. Time: O(2^target), Space: O(target).

tasks.title: Generate Parentheses
tasks.description: Generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses given n pairs.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Constrained Backtracking. Maintain open_count and close_count. Add '(' if open_count < n; add ')' if close_count < open_count. Terminates when string length reaches 2n. Time: O(4^N / sqrt(N)) Catalan number, Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Word Search
tasks.subtopic: 2D Grid DFS with In-Place Visited Rollback
tasks.description: Given m x n grid of characters and string word, return true if word exists in grid moving horizontally or vertically.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Grid DFS Backtracking. Start DFS from every matching first character. Check bounds and character match. Mark board[r][c] = '#' to mark visited; recurse 4 directions; restore board[r][c] on backtrack. Time: O(M * N * 3^L), Space: O(L).

tasks.title: Word Search II
tasks.description: Find all words from dictionary that can be formed by characters of adjacent cells in m x n board.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Trie-Pruned Grid Backtracking. Insert all words into Trie. DFS grid starting from each cell; traverse Trie simultaneously. If grid character is not in current Trie node children, prune immediately. Time: O(M * N * 4 * 3^(L-1)), Space: O(Total Trie Chars).

tasks.title: Sudoku Solver
tasks.description: Solve a 9 x 9 Sudoku puzzle by filling empty cells '.' such that every row, column, and 3x3 subbox contains digits 1-9.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Constraint Satisfaction Backtracking. Find next empty cell. Try digits '1' through '9'. Check if digit is valid in row, col, box. If valid, place digit and recurse; if recursion succeeds return true; else undo placement and try next digit. Time: Exponential O(9^empty), Space: O(81).

tasks.title: N-Queens
tasks.description: Place n queens on n x n chessboard such that no two queens attack each other.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Row-by-Row Board Backtracking. Place queens row by row. Track attacked columns (col), main diagonals (r - c), and anti-diagonals (r + c) using sets or bitmasks. Prune invalid placements in O(1). Time: O(N!), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Flood Fill
tasks.description: Perform flood fill on image starting from pixel (sr, sc) replacing connected pixels of same starting color with newColor.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Connected Component DFS. If starting color equals newColor, return image immediately. Recurse 4 directions changing matching colored pixels to newColor. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N) call stack.

tasks.title: Number of Islands
tasks.description: Given m x n 2D binary grid representing map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), count number of islands.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Connected Components Sink DFS. Scan grid. When '1' found, increment island count and trigger DFS/BFS to sink entire island by converting all connected '1's to '0's. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N).

tasks.title: 01 Matrix
tasks.description: Given m x n binary matrix, return distance of nearest 0 for each cell.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Multi-Source BFS. Enqueue all 0-cells simultaneously with distance 0 and initialize 1-cells to infinity. BFS radiates outward layer-by-layer; first time a 1-cell is visited is guaranteed shortest distance. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N).

tasks.title: Rotting Oranges
tasks.description: Find minimum number of minutes until no fresh orange remains in grid; rotten oranges rot adjacent 4-directional fresh oranges each minute.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Multi-Source Simultaneous BFS. Enqueue all rotten oranges (2s) at minute 0 and count fresh oranges. Each BFS step rots all adjacent fresh oranges (1s) and decrements fresh count. Return minutes when fresh count reaches 0. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N).

tasks.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
tasks.subtopic: Reverse Flow Reachability BFS from Coasts
tasks.description: Find grid coordinates where water can flow to both Pacific (top/left) and Atlantic (bottom/right) oceans.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Reverse Inward BFS/DFS. Flow water backwards (from low to high elevation) starting simultaneously from Pacific borders (top/left) and Atlantic borders (bottom/right). Cells visited by both BFS traversals can reach both oceans. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N).

tasks.title: Shortest Path to Get Food
tasks.subtopic: BFS Shortest Path on Grid with Obstacles
tasks.description: Find shortest path in grid to get food '*' starting from position '*', avoiding obstacle 'X's.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Unweighted Shortest Path BFS. Queue-based BFS starting from player start 'm'. Level-by-level traversal guarantees shortest step count when nearest food '*' cell is dequeued. Mark visited in-place. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N).

tasks.title: Clone Graph
tasks.subtopic: Clone Graph with Hash Map Visited Lookup
tasks.description: Return deep copy (clone) of connected undirected graph.
tasks.notes: Pattern: DFS/BFS with Hash Map. Maintain hash map mapping original_node -> cloned_node. On visiting node, create clone and register in map; recurse on neighbors, attaching cloned neighbors to cloned node. Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V).

tasks.title: Graph Valid Tree
tasks.description: Given n nodes and list of undirected edges, determine if edges form a valid tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Tree Graph Invariant. An undirected graph is a valid tree iff: 1) Number of edges == n - 1, and 2) All nodes are connected (single connected component without cycles verified via DSU or BFS). Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V).

tasks.title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
tasks.subtopic: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
tasks.description: Given n nodes labeled 0 to n - 1 and list of undirected edges, find number of connected components in graph.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find) or BFS/DFS. Initialize count = n. For each edge (u, v), if union(u, v) succeeds, decrement count by 1. Remaining count is number of connected components. Time: O(V + E * alpha(V)), Space: O(V).

tasks.title: Accounts Merge
tasks.description: Merge accounts belonging to same person given list of names and email addresses.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Disjoint Set Union on Emails. Map each email to unique ID and owner name. Union the first email of each account with all subsequent emails in that account. Group emails by root parent, sort emails, and prepend owner name. Time: O(N * K log K), Space: O(N * K).

tasks.title: Course Schedule
tasks.description: Determine if you can finish all courses given prerequisites [a, b] (directed edge b -> a).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Topological Sort / Cycle Detection. Build adjacency list and compute in-degrees. Enqueue all courses with in-degree 0. Dequeue course, decrement in-degree of dependent courses, and enqueue if in-degree becomes 0. If processed count == numCourses, finishable. Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V + E).

tasks.title: Course Schedule II
tasks.description: Return ordering of courses you should take to finish all courses; return empty array if impossible.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Kahn's Topological Order Extraction. Run Kahn's algorithm with queue of 0-in-degree nodes. Append each dequeued node to course order list. If order length equals numCourses, return order; else cycle exists, return []. Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V + E).

tasks.title: Minimum Height Trees
tasks.description: Find all roots of Minimum Height Trees (MHTs) in tree of n nodes.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Leaf-Trimming Topological BFS. Tree centroid can have at most 1 or 2 nodes. Repeatedly remove all degree-1 leaf nodes and their edges layer-by-layer until <= 2 nodes remain in graph. Surviving nodes are MHT roots. Time: O(V), Space: O(V).

tasks.title: Alien Dictionary
tasks.description: Given sorted dictionary of alien language words, derive lexicographical order of alien letters.
tasks.notes: Pattern: DAG Topological Sort on Character Precedence. Compare adjacent words to find first differing character; add directed edge c1 -> c2. Check invalid prefix rule (e.g. 'abc' after 'abcd'). Run Kahn's algorithm; if order length != total unique letters, cycle exists (invalid). Time: O(Total Chars), Space: O(U + E).

tasks.title: All Nodes Distance K in Binary Tree
tasks.subtopic: Tree to Graph Node Mapping + BFS
tasks.description: Find all nodes at distance k from target node in binary tree.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Annotate Parents + Graph BFS. Run DFS to populate parent pointers in hash map, transforming tree into undirected graph. Run BFS outward from target node up to k steps. Time: O(N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Minimum Knight Moves
tasks.description: Find minimum number of steps for knight on infinite chessboard to reach target (x, y).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bidirectional BFS or Quadrant Symmetry. Exploit 8-fold symmetry: map target to first quadrant (abs(x), abs(y)). Run bidirectional BFS from origin and target, meeting in middle to reduce search space from O(8^d) to O(8^(d/2)). Time: O(Steps), Space: O(Steps).

tasks.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
tasks.subtopic: Dijkstra Priority Queue / Bellman-Ford with K Stops
tasks.description: Find cheapest flight price from src to dst with at most k stops.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bellman-Ford (K+1 Relaxations) or Modified Dijkstra. Bellman-Ford relaxes all flight edges k + 1 times using snapshot of previous prices to prevent using > k stops. Time: O(K * E), Space: O(V).

tasks.title: Word Ladder
tasks.description: Find length of shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord changing one character at a time using wordList.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bidirectional BFS. Maintain begin_set and end_set. Always expand smaller set to minimize branching factor. Generate intermediate word variations (*at -> bat, cat); return distance when search frontiers intersect. Time: O(M^2 * N), Space: O(M * N).

tasks.title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
tasks.subtopic: Memoized DFS on Directed Acyclic Graph
tasks.description: Find length of longest increasing path in m x n integer matrix.
tasks.notes: Pattern: DAG Memoized DFS. Since path must be strictly increasing, graph is acyclic. At each cell, DFS 4 directions into strictly greater neighbors: dfs(r, c) = 1 + max(dfs(nr, nc)). Memoize results in dp[r][c] to evaluate each cell once. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(M*N).

tasks.title: Bus Routes
tasks.description: Find least number of buses to take from source bus stop to target bus stop.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Route-Level BFS. Map each stop to list of bus routes passing through it. Run BFS where graph nodes are bus routes (not individual stops) to compress graph; visited set tracks routes already boarded. Time: O(Total Stops on Routes), Space: O(Routes * Stops).

tasks.title: Jump Game
tasks.description: Determine if you can reach last index of array given max jump length at each position.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Greedy Farthest Reach. Track max_reach = 0. Iterate through array; if current index i > max_reach, return false (unreachable). Update max_reach = max(max_reach, i + nums[i]). If max_reach >= n - 1, return true. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Gas Station
tasks.description: Find starting gas station index to travel clockwise around circular route once; return -1 if impossible.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Greedy Prefix Balance. If total_gas < total_cost, complete circuit is impossible (return -1). Maintain running_tank; whenever running_tank < 0, reset start_station = i + 1 and running_tank = 0. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Climbing Stairs
tasks.description: Calculate number of distinct ways to climb to top of staircase with n steps taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 1D Fibonacci DP. Base cases: dp[1] = 1, dp[2] = 2. Transition: dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2]. Maintain two variables (a, b) to compute in O(N) time and O(1) space.

tasks.title: Maximum Subarray
tasks.description: Find subarray with largest sum within integer array nums and return its sum.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Kadane's Algorithm. At each element, either add to running subarray sum or start fresh subarray: curr_sum = max(num, curr_sum + num); max_sum = max(max_sum, curr_sum). Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: House Robber
tasks.description: Determine maximum money you can rob tonight without alerting police (cannot rob adjacent houses).
tasks.notes: Pattern: State Machine DP. At house i: rob = max(rob[i-1], rob[i-2] + nums[i]). Maintain two variables prev1 and prev2 for O(1) space. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Maximum Product Subarray
tasks.subtopic: Dual Min/Max Tracking with Sign Inversion
tasks.description: Find contiguous subarray within integer array that has largest product.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Min/Max Running Product DP. Negative number flips min into max and max into min. Track both max_prod and min_prod at each index: if num < 0, swap max_prod and min_prod; max_prod = max(num, max_prod * num). Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Decode Ways
tasks.description: Determine total number of ways to decode string of digits into letters (1 -> 'A', 26 -> 'Z').
tasks.notes: Pattern: 1D Prefix DP. dp[i] adds dp[i-1] if single digit s[i-1] != '0' (valid 1-9); dp[i] adds dp[i-2] if two digits s[i-2:i] are between '10' and '26'. Maintain two rolling variables. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Word Break
tasks.description: Determine if string can be segmented into space-separated sequence of dictionary words.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 1D Boolean Dynamic Programming. dp[i] is true if s[0:i] can be segmented into words. For each i in 1..n, loop j in 0..i: if dp[j] and s[j:i] in wordSet, dp[i] = true; break. Time: O(N^2), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Unique Paths
tasks.description: Find number of possible unique paths for robot to reach bottom-right corner of m x n grid moving only right or down.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 2D Grid DP. dp[r][c] = dp[r-1][c] + dp[r][c-1]. Optimize to 1D row array: row[c] += row[c-1]. Alternatively compute via combinatorics: (m+n-2) choose (m-1). Time: O(M*N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Maximal Square
tasks.description: Find largest square containing only 1's in binary matrix and return its area.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 2D Minimum Square DP. If matrix[r][c] == '1', dp[r][c] = 1 + min(dp[r-1][c], dp[r][c-1], dp[r-1][c-1]). Track maximum side length seen. Area = max_side * max_side. Time: O(M*N), Space: O(N) optimized.

tasks.title: Coin Change
tasks.description: Find fewest number of coins needed to make up amount; return -1 if impossible.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Unbounded Knapsack DP. Initialize dp array of size amount + 1 with infinity; dp[0] = 0. For each coin, for a in range(coin, amount + 1): dp[a] = min(dp[a], dp[a - coin] + 1). Time: O(amount * len(coins)), Space: O(amount).

tasks.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
tasks.description: Determine if array can be partitioned into two subsets with equal sum.
tasks.notes: Pattern: 0/1 Knapsack Partition DP. If total_sum is odd, return false; target = total_sum // 2. Boolean DP array dp[s] represents whether sum s is achievable. Iterate backwards to prevent element reuse: dp[s] |= dp[s - num]. Time: O(N * target), Space: O(target).

tasks.title: Combination Sum IV
tasks.description: Find number of possible combinations that add up to target positive integer where different sequences are counted as different.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Permutation DP. Target loop is outer, numbers loop is inner: for t in 1..target: for num in nums: dp[t] += dp[t - num] if t >= num. dp[0] = 1. Time: O(target * len(nums)), Space: O(target).

tasks.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
tasks.subtopic: LIS Patience Sorting / Binary Search O(N log N)
tasks.description: Find length of longest strictly increasing subsequence in integer array.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Patience Sorting / Binary Search. Maintain tails array where tails[i] stores smallest tail of all increasing subsequences of length i + 1. Binary search insertion point: if num > all tails append, else replace tails[idx] = num. Length of tails is LIS. Time: O(N log N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling
tasks.subtopic: Weighted Interval Scheduling DP with Binary Search
tasks.description: Find maximum profit in scheduling non-overlapping jobs, each with start, end, and profit.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Weighted Job Scheduling DP + Binary Search. Sort jobs by end time. dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], job.profit + dp[latest_non_overlapping_job]). Binary search finds latest job ending <= job.start in O(log N). Time: O(N log N), Space: O(N).

tasks.title: Single Number
tasks.description: Find single element that appears only once in array where every other element appears twice in O(1) space.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bitwise XOR Cancellation. XORing a number with itself yields 0 (a ^ a = 0), and XOR with 0 yields the number (a ^ 0 = a). XOR all numbers together; all duplicates cancel out, leaving single number. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Missing Number
tasks.description: Find only number in range [0, n] missing from array containing n distinct numbers.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Gauss Sum or XOR. Expected sum is n * (n + 1) // 2. Missing number = expected_sum - sum(nums). Alternatively XOR all numbers in [0, n] with all numbers in array. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Number of 1 Bits
tasks.description: Write function that takes positive integer and returns number of set bits ('1's) in binary representation (Hamming weight).
tasks.notes: Pattern: Brian Kernighan's Algorithm. Operation n & (n - 1) flips the lowest set bit to 0. Loop while n > 0, incrementing count. Loop runs exactly as many times as there are set bits. Time: O(Set Bits), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Counting Bits
tasks.description: Given integer n, return array of length n + 1 where ans[i] is number of 1's in binary representation of i in O(N) time.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bit Counting DP. Number of set bits in i equals bits in right-shifted number plus lowest bit: dp[i] = dp[i >> 1] + (i & 1). Compute in single linear pass. Time: O(N), Space: O(1) auxiliary.

tasks.title: Reverse Bits
tasks.description: Reverse bits of given 32 bits unsigned integer.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Bit Shifting & Masking. Loop 32 times: shift result left by 1 and bitwise OR with lowest bit of n (n & 1); shift n right by 1. Time: O(1) [32 ops], Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Add Binary
tasks.description: Given two binary strings a and b, return their sum as binary string.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Binary String Carry Addition. Pointers at end of strings. In loop: total = carry + (a[i] == '1') + (b[j] == '1'); append total % 2; carry = total // 2. Reverse result string at end. Time: O(max(N, M)), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Palindrome Number
tasks.description: Determine whether integer is palindrome without converting integer to string.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Half-Integer Reversal. Negative numbers and numbers ending in 0 (except 0) are never palindromes. Reverse second half: rev = rev * 10 + x % 10, x //= 10 until x <= rev. Palindrome if x == rev or x == rev // 10. Time: O(log10(N)), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Roman to Integer
tasks.description: Convert Roman numeral string to integer.
tasks.notes: Pattern: Subtraction Rule Accumulation. Map Roman chars to values. If current value is less than next value, subtract current value (e.g. IV = 5 - 1 = 4); otherwise add current value. Time: O(N), Space: O(1).

tasks.title: Reverse Integer
tasks.subtopic: 32-Bit Integer Modulo Reverse with Overflow Guard
tasks.description: Given signed 32-bit integer x, return x with digits reversed; return 0 if reversed overflows [-2^31, 2^31 - 1].
tasks.notes: Pattern: Numeric Reverse with Overflow Check. Extract digits with x % 10. Before rev = rev * 10 + digit, verify rev does not exceed (INT_MAX - digit) // 10. Time: O(log10(N)), Space: O(1).
